mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已关闭' THEN bad_qty ELSE quantity END), 0) FROM wms_production_inbound WHERE work_order_no = #{workOrderNo} AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT * FROM wms_production_inbound WHERE carrier_code = #{carrierCode} AND deleted_at = 0 AND status IN ('待上架', '执行中', '异常待人工') LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_production_inbound SET status = '已入库', task_status = '已完成', stack_code = COALESCE(#{stackCode}, stack_code), complete_time = NOW(), sync_status = '待同步', update_time = NOW() WHERE wcs_task_no = #{taskNo} AND deleted_at = 0 AND status IN ('待上架', '执行中', '异常待人工')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wms_production_inbound WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND status = '已入库' AND ( sync_status IN ('待同步', '同步失败') OR (sync_status = '同步中' AND (last_sync_time IS NULL OR last_sync_time < #{staleBefore})) ) ORDER BY last_sync_time IS NULL DESC, last_sync_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM wms_production_inbound WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND status = '已入库' AND erp_entry_key IS NOT NULL AND erp_entry_key <> '' AND erp_bill_no LIKE 'GXHB%' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_production_inbound SET sync_status = '同步中', last_sync_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = '已入库' AND deleted_at = 0 AND ( sync_status IN ('待同步', '同步失败') OR (sync_status = '同步中' AND (last_sync_time IS NULL OR last_sync_time < #{staleBefore})) )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wms_production_inbound WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND status = '待上架' AND task_status = '未下发' AND submit_time < #{before} ORDER BY submit_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
